_comment: Q1 class projects, in the order they were set. Images live in images/projects/. A caption is the title, the date and the medium — nothing else. An image marked "lead": true spans the full width of its project instead of sitting in the grid.

images.alt: A heart drawn in a single thin line, broken by a horizontal bar across the upper left and a dot at the lower right
A collage of photographs — a foggy coastline, a Kyoto street with a bus, a flag in lights, a church spire, a figure fishing — interleaved with song lyric cards
A numbered list of subjects, among them natural parks, logos, trains, long exposure, fishing, double exposure and museums
A hand-drawn mind map linking parks, wildlife, invasive species, hiking, pollution and fishing around the question of what nature looks like once it is scheduled
A dark room lit green, blue and red, with three figures in one long exposure — one at a computer, one lying down with a phone, one playing bass
A white box truck passing a wall-sized American flag in lights, the flag drawn out by motion

projects.title: Candy Water Droplet
projects.medium: Digital photography — contact sheet and three prints

images.alt: A contact sheet of thirty candy photographs under coloured light, water droplets across each one
Macro photograph of water droplets on red and white candy, each droplet holding an inverted image of the sweets beneath it
Macro photograph of water droplets over multicoloured chocolate buttons, each droplet acting as a lens
Macro photograph of water droplets over orange, green and yellow sweets, each droplet repeating the colours underneath
A six-frame black-and-white sequence of a figure working at a desk set on a ping-pong table, the last frame dark
